proposal.original_text: 找出整数 x 和 y:x 至少是 3,y 至少是 1,两个都不超过 50,x+y 恰好是 7 的倍数,并且 y 不超过 x。这样的整数对存在吗?

model.question: sat
assumptions: x >= 3 and x <= 50 are encoded directly as bounds on x.
y >= 1 and y <= 50 are encoded directly as bounds on y.
'x+y is exactly a multiple of 7' is encoded with auxiliary integer k: x + y = 7k.
k bounds derived from x+y range [4,100]: k must satisfy 7k in [4,100], so k in [1,14]; widened to [-100,100] for neutrality.
'y does not exceed x' is encoded as y - x <= 0.

rendering.text:
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-fun x () Int)
(declare-fun y () Int)
(declare-fun k () Int)
(assert (>= x 3))
(assert (<= x 50))
(assert (>= y 1))
(assert (<= y 50))
(assert (>= k -100))
(assert (<= k 100))
(assert (= (+ (* -7 k) x y) 0))
(assert (<= (+ (- x) y) 0))
(check-sat)
(exit)
